activityWindowFacts.definition: Rolling 1/7/30-day windows ending at 00:00 UTC; most recent day is the preceding complete UTC date
limits: 84 independent daily snapshot frequencies; existing 12 weekly MAU anchors preserved; no cross-snapshot account identity or real events
Country and App platform attribution is fixed in the sample
Product/model attribution is absent and must remain pending, not independently multiplied into these facts
New App DAU/WAU are synthetic additions; existing overall anchors remain unchanged
No inference of causality or calendar-month retention

functionUsage.note: 同一活跃主账号可使用多个功能，各功能人数不可相加。均为合成演示数据。

facts.configDefinition: Account-level in-app notification master setting as of cutoff; independent of OS permission or push delivery
limits: Country/platform only; model/product/device status attribution unavailable
Configuration on/off/unknown is a snapshot of the matching rolling-30-day composite-active cohort
Never sum function marginals; all function users are in the matching App-active subset

deviceRetentionFacts.cohortUnit: complete Monday-Sunday activation week; first image/video day is D0
deviceRetentionFacts.population: Activation occurred while App-bound and not deactivated; entryDeviceStatus frozen at first image/video. Later disposal or unbinding does not remove devices.
deviceRetentionFacts.measurement: D7/D30 are exact UTC calendar-day effective-device behavior; heartbeat excluded. Not a cumulative seven/thirty-day return window. D30 is not a subset of D7.
deviceRetentionFacts.identity: Illustrative immutable identities can be enumerated per fixed synthetic outcome cell; not linked to existing binding or device-activity event sources.

onboardingDurationFacts.quantileMethod: R7 linear percentile on all weighted successful durations, h=(n-1)*p; never average subgroup percentiles; fewer than 30 successes -> counts only

binding.note: 合成首次有效尝试计数。每次成功只归一个耗时取值，失败不填0秒，不计入成功耗时分位数。所有样本为有效设备；非有效状态不构成分母。注册和设备绑定是独立批次，不拼接为同一漏斗。

activation.end: first qualifying bird recognition OR first completed live, whichever occurs first
activation.note: 合成观鸟新注册主账号；全部完成7日观察。每人仅计第一次价值事件，未达成者不填7天代替；成功条件为elapsed<604800秒。示例预设可归属主型号，正式接入必须定义注册人群的型号归属，不能用完成激活后的设备关系反向筛掉未激活者。狩猎线不适用；未使用判定规则不作为注册批次的季节分组。

onboardingDurationFacts.provenance: 经确认用于原型的合成频数；不是日志、不是从分位数反推的实测分布。总体与12期原有计数保留，交叉分组重建后可能不同；版本是合成标签，不代表某次真实版本发布。

A.finding: 观鸟线7日价值激活率从前8周的56.0%降至近4周的48.0%。K6 固件2.8空触发同期上升，但现有数据只支持并发排查。

lineage.reuse: Only each daily country×App-platform active account count; session counts and duration frequencies are newly constructed.

rules: 正式主账号，有效App前台会话；匿名与无主账号会话不计入。
首次有效前台交互开始会话；连续30分钟无有效前台交互后再交互记新会话；UTC零时切分。
时长累计该会话前台区间，后台挂起不计入；缺起止或非正时长不作有效时长样本。
本合成场景所有构造会话均有合格时长；正式接入须分别披露会话总数与合格时长样本数。
人均次数按Session总数／本日App主动活跃主账号；分位数按合并后的Session时长频数用R7计算。
limitations: 口径已确认，全部为合成频数，不是生产日志。
以新构造频数演示，不从现有P50/P90反推真实分布。
国家与平台沿用#25的样例固定归属，不代表实际Session客户端份额；生产需明确跨平台归属和去重。
没有跨日用户身份链，不把84日活跃人数相加作为84日独立用户。
当前仅国家×App平台可重算；App版本、用户类型及逐用户下钻仍缺归属来源。
1—4次是本合成场景采用的频次取值，不是业务上限。
三条趋势使用独立纵轴，只比较各自的方向；频次不等于打开间隔或留存。

userRetentionFacts.measurement: Exact UTC calendar-day compound active; D1/D7/D30 are overlapping day sets, not nested. Unmature weekly cohorts show null for the entire day measure.
userRetentionFacts.provenance: Activation cohort counts and dates reuse device-retention-facts. Candidate first-owner frequency is 90% of each device outcome population after largest-remainder allocation, with new frozen App attribution and new compound-activity outcomes. This is a synthetic mapping scenario, not an observed owner/device link. Registration totals reuse weekly registration anchors where available; 2026-09-14..20 total 2800 and all registration-day outcomes/partitions are new simulations. No other production data is changed.
userRetentionFacts.enrollmentPopulation: Common registration cohorts use the same frozen country x App enrollment counts as #9/#10/#12. Overall day-overlap frequencies are preserved; App assignments are synthetic, not observed identities. The independent 2026-09-14 registration cohort has no matching #9 period.
